name: vfx_lightning_strike_pixel
source: Pinterest pin 825566175496380921 (720x1280 portrait, 60fps, 14.33s full video; ONLY first 5s used per user request)
trim_source_frames: first 5s only: source frames 0-299 at 60fps, sampled every 2nd frame -> 150 frames at 30fps; at the 5s cut the ring is still mid-fade (coverage ~0.03), the effect continues past 5s in the source
method: background subtraction vs median plate of 40 empty tail frames (t=13.5-14.3s, same static camera and checker floor); the two static skill icons at top-right are part of the plate, so they are removed with the background and only the lightning effect remains; soft alpha = clip((max-channel diff-16)/110), crop x 93-700 y 0-1077, NEAREST downscale to 192 wide
blending: normal with transparency; Additive also works for lightning glow
direction: vertical: lightning strikes from top of frame down into a ground ring; ring sits at bottom of frame
download_note: pin page HTML had no direct mp4 (only HLS master playlist); video obtained from the 720w HLS variant's single fragmented-mp4 file (fd8648b2273a35d952d413ebe500418e_720w.cmfv, 720x1280, 60fps)
